# Beagle JAR

Place the Beagle JAR file (e.g., `beagle.27Feb25.75f.jar`) in this directory.

It will be automatically found by `cgiarGenomics::impute_beagle()` at runtime via
`system.file("extdata", package = "cgiarGenomics")`.

Beagle is distributed under the Apache License 2.0.
Download from: https://faculty.washington.edu/browning/beagle/beagle.html
